body:
Coordinator checklist (Termal::Fable2) for the Engram sync cutover. Rev 19 condenses revs 12-18; see those for history. Remove once both hosts have been cut over.

ACCEPTED by Greg („tak jest OK", Asistant 588693a8 #1438): about 2 h of Central outage; ONE-WAY cutover. The old build refuses repaired stores, so rollback means a full restore of the DB, sidecars and old exe, and later writes are lost.

DONE:
- Engram aacb1370 LANDED (ff from 0bd70a30, pushed 15:43:34Z; I verified with ls-remote).
- w-4eab evaluation 4/4 (e2af5490). Option B: the docs moved to w-5f56184f72c1.
- No install until the cutover.
- TermAl master is 73f0fe27 (combo72, w-03b4, landed 15:40:33Z).

RELEASE pins (v1 pinned DEBUG builds, so that package is on HOLD):
- Central: b2fc71a9…, 39366656 B, build cbf98fef…. The Central re-time PASSED (test-4823b5b3): Engram 49.5 min, TermAl 70.5 min, parallel wall ~70.5 min.
- DL560: 5b5ac67e…, 34660784 B, build ddd136df…; repair about 1 s.
- DL560 OLD/rollback: 0c7d8988… (build ce3c7439, source 8fc84451). Central OLD: d4d0182b (build f96cd91d, source 0bd70a30).

PLAN (Engram::Fable #7678, my CONFIRM #7679): Central START 17:45Z. DL560 follows right after Central's readiness. Outage ~75–80 min.
Opus2 (#5751):
- drain at 17:35Z, covering every start including reviews and evaluators;
- census by 17:40Z;
- the TermAl landing freeze returns at 17:35Z, and the master at that moment is final;
- artifact worktrees stay held.
Coders told: edfd #3043, d50d #1347, c593 #1731. Greg got a heads-up via Asistant #1444.

"RESTART NOW" goes through Advisor (session-6219) only after:
(1) Engram::Fable reviews v2 and I review it as a delta from v1. v1 review (#374) found no blocking issue in the logic. Expect only these to change: paths, sha/size pins, build fingerprints, timings, and the leftover-MCP and full-rollback text.
(2) Opus2's census.
(3) The final TermAl master hash.

The notice includes:
- the build hashes and the reason;
- Greg COPIES the TermAl startup console lines (state_load, subphase, listener bound, inventory complete) for w-4fad;
- on Windows, leftover engram MCP processes may survive the TermAl stop. If the guard lists them, Greg closes them and re-runs the paste, which is safe before any mutation;
- the DL560 rollback exe 0c7d8988/ce3c7439;
- after DL560, OFFER (don't do) setting the TermAl project's Engram binaryPath on DL560 to /home/greg/.cargo/bin/engram, since it currently returns 409 "binaryPath not configured";
- Greg's DL560 cleanup list (w-d943694ed8d8).
After the window: lift the freeze, w-7bc3 measurements, and K3 S2b may proceed.

Lessons from today, filed as items:
- w-36d0e270de9d: evaluator spawned on a re-named root (edfd is working on it).
- w-30b524c2bc6b: the 16-record cap.
- Review briefs must not ask reviewers to read whole files (memory termal-large-change-review-coverage rev 3).
